workouts.title: Grip Workout 1
workouts.description: Welcome to Grip Strength Goals Workout 1. For a complete explanation of each movement watch the video above or click the "" for demo. Be sure to document the weight/bands you use in each exercise so we can continue building in the weeks progressing. You can also download a printable copy of today's programming under the Files tab.

sections.name: WORK

items.movement: Movement 2 • 12x Lateral Pinch Red Band Standing Row
Movement 3 • 50m walk x Diagonal Volar Grip with KB
Movement 4 • Spherical Volar Grip (standing - with KB in hand and arm in front)
Rest as needed before starting the next round.
Record weights used for future progressions.

workouts.title: Congratulations! What's next?
workouts.description: Remember, real progress comes from consistent effort and recovery. There’s no quick fix for strength gains, so keep showing up! For continued improvement, repeat the workouts weekly while gradually increasing weight and time under tension. We recommend sticking with the program for at least 3–4 weeks to see results. Have any questions about modifying an exercise or if you're doing it right? Ask it inside the Academy Coaching Space. Looking for your next challenge? Check out our full 8 week courses here or if you’re a WODprep Acamdey athlete check out your Rx Road Map. All the best! - Coach Will & the WODprep Team Thumbnail Photo credit: Alora Griffiths
